stations.name: Portmouth Harbor
stations.blurb: Deep-water quays, gantry cranes, salt and diesel.

stations.name: Marshwick
stations.blurb: Stilt houses, gulls, and the best smoked eel in the Reaches.

stations.name: Dustflats Granary
stations.blurb: Ninety silos of wheat and a level crossing that never stops ringing.

stations.name: Millford
stations.blurb: The market town of the plains — everything passes through here twice.

stations.name: Coalridge Mine
stations.blurb: Black dust, bright lamps, and hoppers that are never empty.

stations.name: Cedarmill Junction
stations.blurb: Four routes meet under one signal box. Mind the switch.

stations.name: Greenhollow
stations.blurb: A green valley town with a covered bridge and a very loud church bell.

stations.name: Ironvale Foundry
stations.blurb: Taps at midnight. The glow is visible from Coalridge.

stations.name: Old Redstone
stations.blurb: Brick and ivy. Rebuild it and the branch wakes up.

stations.name: Pine Pass Depot
stations.blurb: Sawdust, cold air, and flatcars stacked with fresh-cut pine.

stations.name: Snowpeak Summit
stations.blurb: The highest station in the Reaches. Bring sand for the rails.

stations.name: The Summit Loop
stations.blurb: A balloon loop above the clouds. Drive it once, drive it again.
